messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx and crashloops observed for inference-api in prod-ap-south after canary rollout. Paging oncall-sre.
zoe: i'm on it — pulling canary pod state in ap-south cluster.
mike: canary release 2.0.1 went out ~7m ago. introduced an initContainer to migrate shared cache and a hostPath mount for /opt/prefix_cache. also the feature flag 'migrate-hostpath' enabled for canary.
rita: seeing many pods in CrashLoopBackOff, initContainers failing quickly.

zoe: kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-api,release=2.0.1-canary -o wide:
```
NAME                                     READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
inference-api-canary-6c7f8b9d5-4hj2k     0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   12         6m
inference-api-canary-6c7f8b9d5-btq9z     0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   11         6m
```

zoe: logs show initContainer failing with admission webhook message:
```
Error: Pod rejected by pod-security-admission: hostPath mounts are not allowed in namespace "inference-canary"
```

mike: ah — we didn't roll the PSP/PSA exception for canary. The new manifest switched from emptyDir to hostPath to preserve cache across restarts for the migration, but the admission controller denies hostPath in prod namespaces.
rita: that means initContainer never runs and main container never starts; liveness probe eventually fails -> crashloop.

caroline: CS note: approx 3% of requests from ap-south hit the canary slice and experienced 502/504 during rollout window. Tickets being generated for 4 impacted customers.

zoe: mitigation plan: pause the rollout, flip feature flag OFF, create router rule to remove canary from traffic, scale canary to 0, block promotion of 2.0.1 in CD.

zoe: @deploy-bot pause rollout release/2.0.1-canary

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for release/2.0.1-canary. Traffic split frozen. :white_check_mark:

mike: toggling feature flag 'migrate-hostpath' OFF in prod-ap-south.

infra-bot: feature flag 'migrate-hostpath' set to OFF for release=2.0.1-canary in prod-ap-south.

zoe: applying router kill-switch to strip any route with label release=2.0.1-canary.

rita: scaling canary to 0 now to stop crashloops and free node pressure.

zoe: kubectl -n inference scale deploy inference-api-canary --replicas=0

zoe: after scale down, 5xx spikes dropped back to baseline within ~20s. HPA activity normalized.

mike: root cause summary: manifest changed cache persistence from emptyDir to hostPath without updating admission/namespace policy. Admission webhook rejected pods, causing init failure -> crashloops. Two contributing factors: (1) insufficient CI gating for disallowed volume types, (2) router sent ~3% traffic to failing canary causing upstream 5xx for those requests.

caroline: customer comms: sent quick update to impacted customers, noting canary rollout paused and we're investigating. No data loss. Ticket references: #INC2415800123-01..04

rita: remediation items:
- keep feature flag OFF and canary scaled to 0
- block promotion for 2.0.1 in CD pipeline
- revert manifest to emptyDir OR request PSA exception for hostPath with security review
- create hotfix that either uses init job with proper RBAC and volume type or adjust migration to tolerate emptyDir fallback
- add CI check that fails builds when hostPath is used in production helm values

mike: i'll open a hotfix PR to revert to emptyDir and add a migration job that runs as a k8s Job with node selectors if hostPath is needed later. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pull/3791

zoe: runbook: creating incident INC-2026-2415800123, severity SEV2, linking runbook/rollout-admission-failures. tagging postmortem owner: caroline.

sre-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-2415800123. Severity SEV2. Runbook link: runbook/rollout-admission-failures

caroline: i'll own the postmortem and customer follow-up. will draft timeline and root cause in next 24h.

mike: adding e2e lint job: helm lint + scan for disallowed volume types against cluster policy. will add unit test to alert on feature flag combinations that change persistence types.

rita: updating runbook note: before switching volume types in manifests, confirm admission policies and coordinate with infra for exceptions. also add a quick pre-rollout policy check in pipeline.

zoe: keeping monitoring in watch mode for 1 hour. If stable, we will schedule a controlled redeploy to canary using the hotfix (emptyDir) with flag OFF, verify readiness for 10m, then re-evaluate enabling feature flag and promotion gating.

caroline: customers updated. incident mitigated for live traffic. keeping thread open until postmortem complete. thanks all.
